program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-e92bccf9.py'
program_source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    row_counts = {}
    for r, c in points:
        row_counts[r] = row_counts.get(r, 0) + 1
    base_row = max(row_counts, key=row_counts.get)
    base_cols = [c for r, c in points if r == base_row]
    for c in range(min(base_cols), max(base_cols) + 1):
        if out[base_row][c] == 0:
            out[base_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        for rr in range(min(r, base_row), max(r, base_row) + 1):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(program_source)
exec(compile(program_source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())

for r in [7,8]: demo_out_expected[r][10] = 3
for r in [7,8,9,10]: demo_out_expected[r][7] = 3
program_demo_out = transform(demo_in)
print('demo reproduced:', program_demo_out == demo_out_expected)
test_grid = [[0]*17 for _ in range(14)]
for r,c in [(3,6),(6,4),(8,1),(8,12),(10,10),(12,8)]: test_grid[r][c] = 2
